questions.question: On this day in 1100, which Scottish princess married King Henry I and was crowned Queen of England?
questions.explanation: On 11 November 1100, Henry I of England wed Matilda of Scotland, the daughter of King Malcolm III, who was crowned Queen on the same day.
questions.context:
On this day in 1100: Henry I of England marries Matilda of Scotland, the daughter of Malcolm III of Scotland and a direct descendant of the Saxon king Edmund Ironside; Matilda is crowned on the same day.
Henry I of England (King of England from 1100 to 1135): Henry I, also known as Henry Beauclerc, was King of England from 1100 to his death in 1135. He was the fourth son of William the Conqueror and was educated in Latin and the liberal arts.

questions.question: In what fictional US state, loosely modelled on Florida, does Rockstar Games set the open-world map of Grand Theft Auto VI?
questions.explanation: Grand Theft Auto VI is set in the open-world state of Leonida, an analogue of Florida that features the return of Vice City.
questions.context: Grand Theft Auto VI (Upcoming video game): Grand Theft Auto VI is an upcoming action-adventure game developed and published by Rockstar Games. It is due to be the eighth main entry in the Grand Theft Auto series, following 2013's Grand Theft Auto V, and the sixteenth entry overall. Set within the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida, the story follows the criminal duo of Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos. Players will be able to freely roam Leonida's open world, which features the Miami-inspired Vice City.

questions.question: Which airport-set BBC sketch comedy series was created by and starred David Walliams alongside Matt Lucas?
questions.explanation: David Walliams partnered with Matt Lucas to create and appear in Come Fly with Me, which was broadcast between 2010 and 2011.
questions.context: David Walliams (English comedian, writer and actor (born 1971)): David Edward Williams, known professionally as David Walliams, is an English actor, comedian, writer and television personality. He rose to prominence for his work with Matt Lucas on the BBC sketch comedy series Little Britain (2003–2006) and Come Fly with Me (2010–2011). From 2012 to 2022, Walliams was a judge on the television talent competition Britain's Got Talent, for which he received multiple National Television Awards.

questions.question: In which body of water did the American freighter SS Edmund Fitzgerald tragically sink during a fierce storm in 1975?
questions.explanation: The freighter SS Edmund Fitzgerald sank in Lake Superior in November 1975, remaining the largest vessel lost in the Great Lakes.
questions.context: SS Edmund Fitzgerald (Great Lakes freighter sunk in Lake Superior): SS Edmund Fitzgerald was an American Great Lakes freighter that sank in Lake Superior during a storm on November 10, 1975, with the loss of the entire crew of 29 men. When launched on June 7, 1958, she was the largest ship on North America's Great Lakes and remains the largest to have sunk there. Her wreck was located in deep water on November 14, 1975, by a U.S. Navy aircraft detecting magnetic anomalies, and soon afterwards found to be in two large pieces.

questions.question: Before entering politics, U.S. Representative Lauren Boebert operated Shooters Grill, a themed restaurant situated in which American state?
questions.explanation: Lauren Boebert owned Shooters Grill in Rifle, Colorado, where waitstaff were famously encouraged to openly wear sidearms.
questions.context: Lauren Boebert (American politician (born 1986)): Lauren Opal Boebert is an American politician, businesswoman, and gun rights activist serving as the U.S. representative for Colorado's 4th congressional district beginning in 2025, having previously represented Colorado's 3rd congressional district from 2021 to 2025. From 2013 to 2022, she owned Shooters Grill, a restaurant in Rifle, Colorado, where staff members were encouraged to carry firearms openly.
